quarterly_data.quarter: CrowdStrike press release: CrowdStrike Brings the Falcon Platform to the OpenAI (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The Falcon platform became available in the OpenAI Marketplace, so eligible OpenAI enterprise customers can buy CrowdStrike with a portion of their existing OpenAI commitments. Under the expanding partnership Falcon Guardian extends runtime protection to supported OpenAI Codex agents, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Cyber brings cyber reasoning to the Falcon platform, starting with the CrowdStrike Frontier AI Readiness and Resilience (FAIRR) Service.
